description: Lint checks, annotation enforcement, and API version compatibility rules

annotations.name: io.github.libxposed.annotation.SinceApi
annotations.doc: Annotates an API element with the minimum LibXposed API version required (e.g. 101, 102). Modules targeting lower API versions trigger a lint error when referencing it.

annotations.name: io.github.libxposed.annotation.InternalApi
annotations.doc: Marks framework internal classes or methods. Calling these from module code triggers lint warnings/errors and breaks module portability.

apiLevels.name: API_101
features: Modules run strictly within the target package process scope (no zygote injection)
Strongly typed Hooker and Invoker architecture

apiLevels.name: API_102
features: Hot reload support (onHotReloading, onHotReloaded, setSavedInstanceState, getOldHookHandles)
Hook IDs and atomic replacement (HookBuilder.setId, HookHandle.replaceHook)
Modules can stop receiving subsequent lifecycle callbacks
Enforces strict block against calling legacy de.robv.android.xposed APIs

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.annotation.InternalApi

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.annotation.SinceApi

methods.doc: The first Xposed API version that includes the annotated element. @return The first Xposed API version that includes the annotated element.
